responsibility: Declares the public target-side interfaces exported by Darwin support code to the rest of GCC. It centralizes prototypes for Mach-O PIC helpers, section selection and initialization, pragma handlers, file/assembly hooks, exception and DWARF emission helpers, CFString and builtin patching routines, visibility and declaration output helpers, and the enum describing external Darwin toolchain families. This header is the interface contract tying darwin.cc, darwin-c.cc, and architecture-specific Darwin code together.
